completion_data.completion_summary: Created .claude/scripts/literature-briefing-invoke.sh, a failure-surfacing wrapper around literature-briefing.sh, and repointed all 18 Stage 4a invocation sites (3 per skill x 6 skills: skill-researcher, skill-planner, skill-implementer, and their -hard variants) to call it instead of the raw script with 2>/dev/null, so --lit briefing crashes now emit a visible [lit] briefing generation failed (exit N) notice instead of being silently swallowed.

memory_candidates.content: When a shared script is invoked identically at N sites across M files with a silent-failure anti-pattern (script 2>/dev/null || fallback=""), the clean fix is a thin wrapper script that captures stdout, lets stderr flow, inspects the exit code, and emits a visible notice on failure while still exiting 0 to preserve the existing || fallback= call-site semantics. This requires zero call-site restructuring beyond a find/replace of the script name.

When multiple identically-worded comment blocks exist in the same file for different subsystems (e.g. memory_context vs lit_context both ending in '# - script exited with error'), disambiguate Edit tool old_string matches using the distinguishing header line above the comment block (e.g. '# lit_context will be empty string if:' vs '# memory_context will be empty string if:'), not just the trailing line, to avoid accidentally editing the wrong occurrence or triggering a non-unique-match error.
